basis: PHASE1_DESIGN_PACKAGE_20261013.md §3.1 + §7 Open Question 8, resolved per the Phase A review fixes (Issue #1 comment 6155160682): queue and registry keep SEPARATE state vocabularies, joined only by idea_id in materialized drafts. No queue state is ever written into registry.json, and no registry state is ever a queue state.
forbidden_note: PREREGISTERED and ELIGIBLE are human-process states outside the pipeline. The writer refuses any transition to them (fixture F5 is the mechanical proof).

BLOCKED-DATA.meaning: No draft. Re-check only if the named data route changes.

DISCOVERED.meaning: Exists only inside a run; never persisted, never drafted.

INGESTED.meaning: No draft. Card exists in the pipeline store only.

PARKED.meaning: No draft. May be re-checked by a later run (max once per quarter).

REJECTED.meaning: No draft, ever. Failure memory lives in the queue log + family ledger only.

SHORTLISTED.meaning: The ONLY queue state that materializes into a registry-shaped draft. The draft is not a registry entry; merging is a separate human-approved step outside Phase A.

registry_state_note: Observed states are free-text in the pinned registry blob (sha256 86600c0775bccb9d…, 21 experiments) and one entry's state field contains a full verdict sentence (EXP-20261012-TIMESFM-SPIKE). The queue vocabulary deliberately does not reuse any of these strings except by coincidence of meaning; see coverage_limits in registry_backfill.json.
